notes.title: Patch changelog 28 August 2012
notes.content:
[h1][b]Changelog[/b][/h1]

- Fixed menu UI to support DLC
- Added large screen mode (1200 x 900).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30951208/3d15244f26c661e2c43e191a548815fc026f47b3.png[/img]
Original 800 x 600 screen

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30951208/a3720f63f22be7a40e81a355ded63eae8449e0d3.png[/img]
New 1200 x 900 screen

This can be adjusted from the new options on the options page.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30951208/8ae6632fd2e28d55424e7a4ef65154255eed8d08.png[/img]

- Added information telling which file the last save was. and add save timestamp.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30951208/422f615c3138972983bf6636f968b7925de352e6.png[/img]

- Added two new menu page animations (requires openGL3 support to see)
- Added some animations in some CGs and characters.
